businesses.business: Life science tools and specialty diagnostics

offering_description.value: Revvity sells laboratory instruments, reagents, informatics software, and specialty diagnostic tests for life science researchers, drug developers, and clinical laboratories. It integrates these products into laboratory workflows and provides contract research, manufacturing, clinical genetic testing, and technology licensing.

quotes.quote: Revvity offers comprehensive life science solutions, technologies, and services, covering workflows from discovery to cure. We revolutionize biomedical research with a focus on translational multi-omics, biomarker identification, imaging, prediction, screening, detection, diagnosis, informatics, and more.

Collaborate with our skilled scientists and experts to reach your goals sooner. Our range of contract services supports preclinical oncology drug discovery, viral vector manufacture, omics discovery, the development of genetic disease treatments, and clinical genetic testing. We also provide novel licensable technologies for gene expression, editing, and delivery to help you bring safer, more effective treatments to patients.

primary_products.value: Laboratory automation and analytical instruments; imaging systems; antibodies and research reagents; informatics software; diagnostic assays and screening kits

quotes.quote: Revvity brings together AI-powered informatics, automation, reagents, imaging, analytical technologies, and scientific expertise to power connected Lab-in-the-Loop workflows that transform biological data into actionable scientific insight.

Our specialty portfolio delivers innovative, end-to-end solutions for identifying and investigating a broad range of immune system disorders. We integrate cutting-edge technologies, such as immunoassays, molecular assays, automation, and advanced software - to enable seamless workflow integration, ultimately expanding research and testing for these highly complex diseases.

primary_services.value: Preclinical drug discovery and genomic screening; omics research; contract viral vector manufacturing; genetic therapy development support; clinical genetic testing

quotes.quote: Collaborate with our skilled scientists and experts to reach your goals sooner. Our range of contract services supports preclinical oncology drug discovery, viral vector manufacture, omics discovery, the development of genetic disease treatments, and clinical genetic testing. We also provide novel licensable technologies for gene expression, editing, and delivery to help you bring safer, more effective treatments to patients.

Identify targets with therapeutic potential through Revvity's functional genomic screening CRO services. Using advanced technologies such as CRISPR, RNAi, and base editing, we help drug discovery teams better understand the networks of genes and pathways regulating disease pathologies. Our functional genomic screening services deliver deep genetic insights, uncover novel synthetic lethal targets, provide an understanding of a therapeutic's MOA, stratify patients for responders and non-responders, and explore drug repurposing or combination strategies.
